title: Transfer of one-sided limits at 0⁺ to a positive null sequence with a finite constant factor
statement: Let f, h : ℝ → [0,∞], let C ∈ [0,∞] with C ≠ ∞, and let s : ℕ → ℝ satisfy s_i > 0 for every i and s_i → 0 as i → ∞. Then (i) if limsup_{r→0⁺} f(r) ≤ 1 (limsup along 𝓝[>] 0), then limsup_{i→∞} C·f(s_i) ≤ C; and (ii) if h(r) → 0 as r → 0⁺ (along 𝓝[>] 0), then C·h(s_i) → 0 as i → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (f h : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (C : ℝ≥0∞) (s : ℕ → ℝ), C ≠ ∞ → (∀ i, 0 < s i) → Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 0) → (limsup f (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ 1 → limsup (fun i => C * f (s i)) atTop ≤ C) ∧ (Tendsto h (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun i => C * h (s i)) atTop (𝓝 0))
